user.title: Connect to NuaSense
user.description: An API key from platform.nuasense.com → API Keys, with the ingest:write scope. It reads your NuaSense stations and, if you choose, registers a station Home Assistant already has.

station.title: Your station and your garden
station.description: Watering today is worked out for what the garden mostly is. The sprinkler rate turns millimetres into minutes; use 0 if you only want millimetres. Advanced adds the agronomy values (spray window, ET0 per hour, leaf wetness, VPD, delta T).

ha_station.title: Send a station to NuaSense
ha_station.description: These devices have an outdoor temperature and humidity. Pick the weather station to send.

ha_sensors.title: {station}: what is sent
ha_sensors.description:
These sensors go to NuaSense every five minutes, together with the position set in Home Assistant (Settings → System → General). Temperature and humidity are required; leave out what you do not have. The station counts as one of the free stations on your NuaSense account.

What happens with the data: NuaSense stores the readings and the position to compute your frost, watering and spray values. The readings are also used aggregated and anonymised to improve forecasts and models; they are never passed on individually without your consent. Remove the integration to stop sending, and delete the station in the NuaSense console to delete its data.
